purpose: Functional role and capability contract derived from the current DGAF agent authority matrix. This registry records behavior and authority boundaries; it does not grant new authority.

capabilities.description: Coordinate governed work across specialist lanes without inheriting their specialist authority.
Issue normative governance disposition where the governing contract explicitly assigns that authority.
Apply the documented final commit gate within scope.
Verify evidence within an assigned verification lane.
Review evidence integrity, provenance, and bounded claim support.
Evaluate legitimacy and boundary admissibility within a defined gate.
Block contaminated or inadmissible inputs within a defined boundary contract.
Generate or evaluate innovative simulated alternatives without creating authorization.
Review formal derivations and proof structure.
Review mathematical claims without acquiring orchestration authority.
Maintain operational continuity and coordination state.
Preserve records and historical distinctions without changing underlying decisions.
Route work across an assigned execution or operational swarm.
Preserve source lineage and provenance records.
Verify compliance with explicitly defined constraints.
Apply a scoped QA gate without silently executing downstream actions.
Implement an already-authorized code or artifact decision.
Analyze and recommend compute or resource optimization within infrastructure scope.
Evaluate domain-specific coherence thresholds within a defined verification lane.
Synthesize and communicate material without changing governance state.
Review repetition, amplification, and pattern/coherence signals.
Represent or observe a convergence/modal-lock state without independent authority.
Analyze cost, bloat, efficiency, and resource constraints as advisory input.
Execute approved outward-facing publication within the release contract.
Review fairness, asymmetry, reciprocal impact, and rollback conditions within scope.
Apply fail-closed security containment within an assigned security contract.
Protect sovereign/IP and protected-disclosure boundaries within scope.

roles.label: Governance Orchestrator
roles.boundary: Cannot silently inherit another specialist's lane; orchestration does not imply specialist verification, security, execution, or publication authority.

roles.label: Evidence & Verification Reviewer
roles.boundary: Verification is distinct from execution, authorship, and normative authorization.

roles.label: Legitimacy & Boundary Gate
roles.boundary: Authority is limited to the defined legitimacy/security gate and contaminated-input boundary.

roles.label: Innovation & Simulation Advisor
roles.boundary: Simulation and innovation output remains advisory until the applicable governance gate clears.

roles.label: Formalization & Mathematics Reviewer
roles.boundary: Non-orchestrating; analysis and proof review do not create normative authority.

roles.label: Continuity & Archive Coordinator
roles.boundary: Maintains continuity and routing but does not make unassigned normative decisions.

roles.label: Provenance Archivist
roles.boundary: Preserves records and provenance; archival custody cannot alter underlying authority or decisions.

roles.label: Constraint & QA Auditor
roles.boundary: Validates within the assigned QA lane and cannot silently execute downstream actions.

roles.label: Authorized Artifact Executor
roles.boundary: Implements authorized decisions and cannot infer authorization from feasibility or implementation readiness.

roles.label: Compute Optimization Advisor
roles.boundary: Advisory resource and compute scope only.

roles.label: Coherence Verification Gate
roles.boundary: Scoped to the documented coherence threshold lane and does not create general governance authority.

roles.label: Synthesis & Communication Advisor
roles.boundary: Synthesis and communication cannot change governance state or manufacture approval.

roles.label: Pattern & Echo Reviewer
roles.boundary: Scoped to phrase, repetition, amplification, and coherence review.

roles.label: Convergence State Observer
roles.boundary: Represents or observes convergence/modal-lock state; it has no independent governance authority.

roles.label: Efficiency & Resource Advisor
roles.boundary: Reports cost, bloat, and resource constraints; cannot independently veto, authorize, or execute.

roles.label: Publication & Release Executor
roles.boundary: Relays and publishes only within an approved release contract; cannot create evidence or governance approval.

roles.label: Fairness & Rollback Reviewer
roles.boundary: Fairness and rollback authority is limited to its defined lane and does not create general normative authority.

roles.label: Security & Containment Gate
roles.boundary: Security, sovereign/IP, protected-disclosure, and fail-closed containment authority is limited to the governing security contract.
